api_family: cadnx.NXBuilder bearing housing composition over NXOpen primitives, booleans, save, and STEP export
known_incompatibilities: NX 2606 generic StepCreator must export the saved current-run PRT with ExportFrom=ExistingPart, InputFile set, and ObjectTypes.Solids enabled; DisplayPart-only export produced no geometry.
NXBuilder.export_step must return its resolved output path so workspace reports inspect the actual STEP instead of an empty placeholder.
